entries.legacyBehavior: Hashes only projectPath and reuses one mutable profile root after configuration changes.
entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Same manifest produces the same revision; concurrent writers publish one complete revision.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Partial staging is discarded; missing or corrupt pinned revision is a typed recovery outcome.

entries.legacyBehavior: Creates per-project HOME, tmp, XDG config, and XDG data roots.
entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Layout creation is idempotent; mutable state is isolated per runtime instance.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Validate permissions and free space before activation.

entries.legacyBehavior: Shares npm, browser, Python, node-gyp, tool, and OpenCode node_modules caches.
entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Provider-specific lock and repair protocol; never rely on cache for authoritative state.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Quarantine corrupt entries and rebuild without changing the pinned revision.

entries.legacyBehavior: Copies only provider, model, and small_model from ambient config and silently drops the rest.
entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Resolve one stable source snapshot before materialization.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Unsupported or unsafe fields are rejected or reported, never silently omitted.

entries.legacyBehavior: Scans selected project files and directories; desktop scanner hashes mtime and silently stops at 200 files.
entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Detect source drift during scan and retry a bounded number of times.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Truncation, unreadable entries, cycles, or mutation yield typed failure.

entries.legacyBehavior: Uses regular expressions to strip comments and can miss valid MCP declarations inside JSONC containing slash-like string data.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Invalid documents fail with path and parser diagnostics.

entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Reserved identity is derived deterministically from the resolved manifest.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Normalized-name collisions fail before process start.

entries.legacyBehavior: Builds teammate, bootstrap, and model-probe agents with orchestration-specific names and tool policies.
entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Grant revision is pinned with the profile manifest.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Unsupported provider permissions fail capability negotiation.

entries.errorsAndRecovery: Expired, revoked, corrupt, and refresh-uncertain are distinct outcomes.

existingTests: legacy Cursor and Kiro bridge tests

entries.legacyBehavior: Uses an in-process queue for whole preparation and a file lock only around node_modules symlink repair.
entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: Works across processes and hosts through repository semantics, not a static map.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Expired work is fenced; abandoned staging directories are garbage-collected.
existingTests: legacy preparation queue and symlink race tests

entries.errorsAndRecovery: Unknown canonicalization version is incompatible, not silently recomputed.

entries.idempotencyAndConcurrency: No deterministic guarantee while ambient files remain writable.
entries.errorsAndRecovery: Drift produces an observation and requires explicit rematerialization for deterministic execution.
